title: Jesus you are my salvation
lyrics: Jesus you are my way home
Where you are on your mighty throne
When it´s my time to leave this world behind me
When it´s my time to spread my wings
Lord I want to be found worthy
Because it´s your face that I long to see
I remember my sad days of sorrow
I remember being down on my knees
Then you touched me and my eyes were opened
And now it´s your face that I long to see.
